First Time Experience with Coca Tea
Placed 5 bags of coca tea into a small pot of boiling water, boiled for 5 minutes. Added four pieces of ice and drank the tea in less than 3 minutes. WOW! Half way through the tea I began smiling with a huge grin. Took 2 hits off the cannapipe and got ready for work. Mild euphoria went on for about 2 hours accompanied by a PROFOUND sense of clarity, happy, and energy.
Tea was marked decocanized- but I was certainly impressed with the amount of surging energy I got off drinking a $5 cup of tea.
